title: Full Stack Integration - Part 1
description: Full-stack integration of React frontend with Node.js/Express backend, covering authentication, CRUD operations, forms, validation, file uploads, and database integration. This submodule covers: React + Node, Frontend/backend architecture, API integration, Authentication, CRUD.
learning_outcomes: Build full-stack applications with React and Node.js
Implement RESTful API communication between frontend and backend
Manage application state with React hooks and context
